lignes.texte: Your demands get concrete answers. Against diesel prices: fewer empty kilometres and more income per trip. Against illegal transport: an app reserved for licensed taxis. On fares: anonymous figures to support your negotiations. On contracts: clear statements for every driver. And one driver account, valid in every city.
And with the income Bab Taxi pays it, the union can help its members directly: fuel support, a mutual aid fund, training, and help desks for drivers.
